title: of the multi-composed latest names, how many extra composers are doctor harnesses and does any leave a mutated face behind?

population_source.self_exclusion_note: this study writes latestdoctor_latest.json itself; its own producer is excluded from the scan, so leaving the name in would have published a face whose only visible composer is a harness -- a self-inclusion artefact, not a finding

role_rule.a_producer: everything else in the scanned sources

population_source.live_arm: each published path is opened and parsed as JSON at build time; leftover mutant artefacts are listed from results/state_tilt

role_definition.a_producer: a source that is not a leg runner and not a one-off _rNNN repair

discipline_definition.writes_the_name_twice_so_it_can_put_the_: two or more write sites for the same name in one source, so the second can put the original back
discipline_definition.writes_the_name_once_with_no_restore_in_: exactly one write site: nothing in that source restores it

method_limits: static plus a JSON parse: parses_as_json=false is evidence of a mutated face, parses_as_json=true is NOT evidence that the content is the producer's
two write sites in one source says a restore is possible in that source, not that it ran or that the rest of the run finished
role is a file-name rule: a harness living under another name is counted as a producer
leftover_mutant_files lists names, not provenance: a *_bak file may be an intentional fixture
the population is E491's static population; a name whose composers are all harnesses says the producer folded out of reach, not that it does not exist
